english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) to which section 47 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 applied and as respects which no test certificate had been issued within the appropriate period
english.legislation: Contrary to section 47(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H69 and H70
(iii) Important Note: fixed penalty procedure may be applied
(iv) This offence wording applies to a vehicle under 3500kgs gross vehicle weight. For the similar offence in relation to goods vehicles exceeding that weight limit see CJS Code RT88098 and Standard Offence Wording H321.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was first registered in **(..SPECIFY MONTH AND YEAR..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when there was no test certificate in force for the vehicle.
